title: GASAK
summary: A complete esports organization operating system for squads, recruitment, tournaments, match records, publishing, commerce, payments, and role-specific staff workflows.
overview: GASAK is a full-stack operating platform for a Malaysian Mobile Legends organization. A public site presents the organization, squads, tournaments, news, recruitment, gallery, and storefront; the authenticated application gives admins, sellers, leaders, coaches, and players purpose-built workspaces. It manages rosters, applications, schedules, scrims, tournament rounds, match results, news publishing, merchandise, game accounts, rank-boost packages, orders, payment evidence, reports, galleries, audit logs, and integrations. Better Auth and a layered authorization model protect organization and squad scopes, Drizzle supports PostgreSQL with a local PGlite fallback, and the platform integrates Billplz webhooks, Discord automation, Challonge, Resend, UploadThing, and scheduled operational digests.
highlights: Dual-scope authorization separates organization roles from squad roles, including a Manage/Player focus for users who wear both hats.
Squad and player operations cover rosters, lanes, recruitment stages, schedules, scrims, tournament rounds, Challonge data, and match results.
Public publishing system for organization pages, news, galleries, squads, tournaments, and recruitment applications.
Commerce supports merchandise, game accounts, rank-boost packages, guest order lookup, payment evidence, Billplz webhooks, and seller workflows.
Role-specific dashboards, searchable command palette, reports, audit logs, media management, Discord settings, and scheduled digests.
Better Auth, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL/PGlite, Resend, and UploadThing provide authentication, persistence, email, and media infrastructure.
